current.material_quality_content:
We founded the lab-grown diamond industry in 2005 out of activism, making MiaDonna the world's first lab grown diamond and lab grown gemstone company. We are the experts in diamonds and gems created in a lab, so you don’t have to be!

Sustainability: MiaDonna metals and lab grown diamond are certified sustainable by SCS Global and Carbon Neutral. Our company is also certified by B Corporation, so you can trust that we not only meet but exceed the highest social and environmental standards.

Diamonds: We only offer Premium lab grown diamonds. This means our lab grown diamonds are harder and brighter than other diamonds (earth mind or lab grown) on the market. You will only find this at MiaDonna.

Jewelry: MiaDonna jewelry is handcrafted just for you when you order it, unless noted otherwise. You build it online or with a MiaDonna jewelry specialist and our master jewelers will create it for you.
current.product_shipping_content:
COMPLIMENTARY SHIPPING
Each MiaDonna piece is handcrafted to order in about 2–3 weeks. Every order ships insured and signature-required via FedEx 2Day within the U.S. or DHL Express Worldwide (2–5 days, 50+ countries). FedEx Overnight is available at checkout for U.S. customers.

60-DAY RETURNS & EXCHANGES
We're confident you'll love your MiaDonna jewelry, but if it isn't exactly as you imagined, you have 60 days from the shipment date to return or exchange it, complimentary. No restocking fees. Items must be unworn, in original condition, with the MiaDonna silver tag attached.

settings.subtitle: You Hold the Power to End Conflict Diamonds
settings.title: At MiaDonna, we love the beauty of diamonds. We love their sparkle and the dreams they represent, but at what cost? Unfortunately, newly mined diamonds don’t just come with a high price tag, they also come with a high price to earth and humanity. And that’s not a price most of us are willing to pay.
settings.text: Consumer demand drives the production of products, so we are the driving force to decide what is available on the market, the price, and the chain of supply. Real change will only come through action, motivated by the sincere understanding of the impact of our decisions. It's time to make a choice. We finally hold the power.

settings.quote_text: Over the last six years, it is estimated that 60 million carats of confirmed blood diamonds hit the international market and are now being purchased by unassuming consumers. And these are just the numbers we know about!
Despite what the earth-mined diamond industry wants you to believe, the mining, distribution and sale of conflict diamonds is still a major problem that needs to be addressed.

settings.left-text: 100% of the diamonds sold by “Company Name” are certified by The Kimberly Process to have come from conflict-free sources.
settings.right-text: You might have seen a message like this when purchasing an earth-mined diamond, but please do not be fooled. The Kimberley Process has failed us and there is no such thing as a “conflict free” earth-mined diamond source.

settings.quote_text: Diamonds mined, for example, in Zimbabwe which is notorious for killing, raping and maiming hundreds of artisinal miners are considered “conflict-free” under the KPCS.

settings.subtitle: About the founder
settings.title: In 2005, Anna-Mieke had the vision to create a conflict-free diamond and has led the evolution of the lab-created diamond industry ever since.
settings.text:
Anna-Mieke Anderson (pronounced AnnaMeeka), is the Founder and active CEO of MiaDonna & Company.

MiaDonna & Company (named after the founder's daughter Mia and mother Donna) was established in 2005 in Portland, Oregon.

The company was born out of Anna-Mieke’s desire to put a modern twist and feminine touch on an industry heavily dominated by men and unethical standards. Fueled by a mother's passion for helping children, Anna-Mieke has built a globally admired eco-friendly jewelry company that continues to push boundaries to create a socially responsible diamond industry.

When Anna-Mieke learned the truth behind the origin of her earth-mined diamond, she became passionate about finding a conflict-free option and soon learned that the only true diamond free of any conflict was going to be man-made. Anna-Mieke has since dedicated her life to creating diamonds in a lab environment that are superior to earth-mined diamonds in every way while helping children caught in the middle of the unethical harvesting of diamonds.

“There is no need to mine for diamonds or gold anymore, it is an outdated industry and not right for today's society. We can now grow diamonds in a modern-day lab environment or source them from a recycled origin to prevent any destruction to native communities, societies or the earth.”

settings.subtitle: HONORS & AWARDS
settings.title: In the words of Estee Lauder, “I never dreamed of success. I worked for it.”
DIAMOND MINING COMMUNITIES
settings.description: Traditional earth-mined diamonds fund wars, damage economies and contribute to the killing, maiming and displacing of innocent people. As a MiaDonna consumer, you directly contribute to the funding of Greener Diamond projects that empower and restore these diamond mining communities.

settings.title: GLOBAL SOCIETIES
settings.description:
We don't answer to shareholders, board members, mining companies, or corporations. As a social enterprise, our goal is to improve the quality of living for global societies.

As a shopper, you have the choice to buy ethically. We make it easy for you to find a product you not only love but one with a mission you can stand by. With your purchase, not only will you feel good but you’ll do good too.

settings.title: THE EARTH
settings.description:
Mining is both catastrophic for local community members and the environment. Each year, more than 150 million carats of diamonds are extracted from the Earth resulting in the removal and displacement of enormous amounts of soil. Additionally, these mining efforts create irreversible damage to ecosystems.

In this day and age, there is no longer a need to mine for precious gemstones or metals. Our products are crafted only from conflict-free diamonds and gemstones and recycled precious metals.
